item.title: Mama tte Yonde mo Ii no ka na? ~Watashi ga Aka-chan ni Naru made~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Kumitate Tsunoryuu
  • 発売日: 2022-06-10
  • スコア: 6.779999999999999/10 (21 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ママって呼んでもいいのかな？ ～私が赤ちゃんになるまで～
  • 英語名: Mama tte Yonde mo Ii no ka na? Watashi ga Aka-chan ni Naru made

あらすじ

Ichika, a young girl in the pharmacy department of a university, was busy balancing her daily studies with a part-time job to earn money for university fees.

She was in danger of one day having to stay in university.

Then she hears a story about a friend of hers who made a lot of money with a secret part-time job.

item.title: Kumotta Hitomi ni Koishiteru
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Kumitate Tsunoryuu
  • 発売日: 2019-04-08
  • スコア: 6.65/10 (6 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 曇った瞳に恋してる
  • 英語名: Kumotta Hitomi ni Koishiteru

あらすじ

It’s weirdly loud in the classroom today…

Huh? A girl from another class slit her wrist?

That’s awful…

Which reminds me, I cut myself really bad with a chisel back in grade school!

That hurt so much the color drained from my face.

At some point, I saw her… Sanshiki Sumire, that is. I’m glad her wound doesn’t seem all that serious♪
